# warning-icon.png

**Type:** Small warning icon (an orange/yellow triangle with an
exclamation mark), not a diagram.
**Source context:** `### Shipping Order & Shipment definition` section,
used inline three times to flag open concerns in the narrative: next to
"POOM triggers a ShippingOrder to SP supply chain..." (the reference of
the productOrder is passed), next to the note that product configuration
is defined through ShippingOrder → shippingOrderItem → Shipment while
POOM cannot compute the shipment (a Logistic responsibility), and next to
"Logistic Partner triggers shipment request to transport partners...".
Purely a visual flag marking each point as an open issue/caution; carries
no structural information of its own.
